Jordan H.: Heads-up — product asked for a single line in the cost dashboard that shows per-model economics for multi-model chains (prompt -> embed -> generator -> reranker). Right now we show only end-to-end token cost which hides where the money goes. Any objections to adding a per-model breakdown column?
Felix S.: +1 from me. Important: attribution is tricky when tokens are shared (e.g., generator reuses embeddings). We need a deterministic split rule. Propose: attribute direct tokens to the model that generated them; attribute reused context tokens proportionally by CPU-time or token-count contribution.
Amira K.: Sounds reasonable. UX ask: show both "raw" and "apportioned" columns. Raw = what each model consumed, Apportioned = what billing will reflect after amortized shared-costs. Also add a tooltip explaining split rule and a link to the policy.
Nikhil S.: Implementation note: the preview API can return a new field `per_model_breakdown` as CSV-like string: "generator:1200t|embed:300t|reranker:150t" and `apportioned_breakdown`: "generator:1350t|embed:250t|reranker:150t". Keep it flat so Console can parse without nested JSON.
Jordan H.: Example of the new API call we discussed earlier: POST /api/cost_preview {route:"search-chain",mode:"amortized",split_rule:"time-proportional"} -> response includes `drivers` and `per_model_breakdown`. Can infra make the response stable for Dashboards?
Felix S.: We'll add a deterministic sort order and human-friendly keys. Also emit `chain_id` so the frontend can group multi-step chains.
Amira K.: Quota interaction: if routing policy sends 10% to an expensive reranker on heavy load, can we show the effective per-route quota usage and projected overage? We need to warn owners when a small % to an expensive model inflates tenant spend.
Nikhil S.: We'll add `quota_impact_estimate` as another flat string: "route:search-chain,quota:compute_gpus,delta:0.12". Console can surface a small warning if delta>0.1.
Jordan H.: One more: cache credits and KV hits should be shown next to per-model costs. Suggest `kv_credit` field like "embed:120,generator:0" that UI can label as "cache savings (tokens)".
Felix S.: We'll expose `kv_credit` and a `confidence_band` Low/Med/High based on telemetry sample_rate. If sample_rate<0.05 we mark as Low.
Amira K.: UX acceptance: show per-model rows collapsed by default with a tiny chevron and a copy button to export the breakdown as CSV. Also add a short copy: "Apportioned numbers reflect shared context and amortized transcode costs; use advanced mode for marginal warmed-run estimates."
infra-bot: Ticket INF-9342 created: "per-model chain cost breakdown + quota impact metadata" assigned to @Felix S.
Jordan H.: Thanks — this will help product-safety and reduce billing surprise in demos. Felix/Amira please loop finance for the exact amortization windows.
Felix S.: Will do. I'll start on the API shape and post a proto response here.
Amira K.: I'll mock the UI and send screenshots.
Jordan H.: Great. Closing the thread for now.
